text: Malaysia banned Robert Spencer's The Politically Incorrect Guide to Islam (And The Crusades) on 30 July 2009. The Ministry of Home Affairs gazetted the ban under the Printing Presses and Publications Act.
meta_description: The Politically Incorrect Guide to Islam (And The Crusades) by Robert Spencer: banned in Malaysia on 30 July 2009 under the Printing Presses and Publications Act.
